text_block_list.text:
While Inari One was walking near the 
station with a friend—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, they're holding a rakugo workshop 
event? Sounds intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Inari-chan, that sign says, "Learn how to 
use folding fans and hand towels." What's 
that all about?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
In rakugo, we express everything with just 
a folding fan and a hand towel.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A folding fan can serve as chopsticks, a 
brush, or a sword, and a hand towel can 
become a letter, a pouch, or a wallet.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Chopsticks...? A letter...? The mystery 
only deepens...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I guess trying to explain it is just 
missing the point. This is something you 
have to see, not hear about.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go take a quick peek. 
Seeing is believing, after all.

Inari One only intended to spend a little 
time at first, but she lost track of time, 
got totally absorbed in it, and ended up 
skipping training.
